title: [Master]-Customer Ledger Bill Entries display default Customer Posting Group instead of Alternative Customer Posting Group set on Sales Documents in the Spanish version.
summary: Invoice split payment posting in the Spanish version now preserves the alternative customer posting group from sales documents instead of defaulting to the customer's current posting group.
key_points: Fixed incorrect posting group assignment when creating bill and close invoice journal lines
Posting group now explicitly set from the original sales document instead of defaulting at posting time
Affects Spanish localization for invoice split payment processing
Customer ledger entries now show the correct alternative posting group
Added test coverage for cartera posting scenarios
